title: Quantum algorithms for the fractional Poisson equation via rational approximation
summary: This paper presents a quantum algorithm for solving the fractional Poisson equation \((-Δ)^s u = f\) with \(s \in (0,1)\) on bounded domains. The proposed approach combines rational approximation techniques with quantum linear system solvers to achieve exponential quantum advantage. The rational approximation represents the inverse fractional Laplacian as a weighted sum of standard resolvents, transforming the original nonlocal problem into a collection of shifted integer-order partial differential equations.
